headline: ROGUE gets an ending — and main got healed first
lede: The night opened on a red main: PONG's centre tap had died under last night's RANGE dial, freezing every merge. Slot b fixed that first (the switch bank is now columns — the field centre is always tappable), cleared the freeze with a green nightly refresh, then the never-dry ladder pointed at ROGUE. It shipped the goal object the 1980 dungeon was always about: the Amulet of Yendor.

notes.text: Main green again: a phone's centre-tap on PONG landed on the new RANGE button and did nothing — the tapstart nightly caught it. Dial zones are label columns now; the any-tap-to-start law holds at the field centre (#3584, prod-verified, refresh nightly green).

ROGUE now has the Amulet of Yendor: one golden goal on monster level 20, and the pickup ends the run — the cart's line, a YOU WIN card, gold + depth score. Every dungeon below dlvl 20 replays byte-identical to the pre-amulet cart, pinned against goldens from the old sim.
Both terminals stay honest: six seeds reach the Amulet and win; two die on the way — dlvl 20 still kills, exactly as the 1980 depth intended. The WATCH guide hunts it when you dare the descent.
Queued for the next lane: the pack still calls the Amulet '?' in ROGUE's inventory (#3601) — a quick honest fix.
